hook: The founder of fascism, dictator of Italy and ally of Hitler.

pages.x: Benito Mussolini was born in 1883 in Predappio, in northern Italy, the son of a socialist blacksmith and a teacher. He was named after the Mexican president Benito Juárez. As a boy he was expelled from school for stabbing a classmate.

He became a socialist journalist, but was thrown out of the party in 1914 for backing the war. In 1919 in Milan he founded the fascist movement, whose black-shirted squads beat and killed socialists and trade unionists.
In October 1922 thousands of Blackshirts marched on Rome. Rather than fight them, the king made Mussolini prime minister, at 39 the youngest in Italy's history.
By 1925 he was dictator, Il Duce, "the leader". He banned other parties, censored the press, and had opponents jailed, exiled or murdered, like the socialist politician Giacomo Matteotti.
His propaganda boasted that he had made the trains run on time. In fact much of the railway had been repaired before he came to power, and plenty of trains still ran late.
In 1935 he invaded Ethiopia, using poison gas. In 1940 he joined Hitler in the Second World War, but his armies were beaten in Greece and North Africa.

In 1943, after the Allies landed in Sicily, his own fascist council voted against him and the king had him arrested. German commandos freed him from a mountain hotel, and he ruled a puppet state in the north for Hitler.
In April 1945, fleeing toward Switzerland in a German uniform, he was caught by Italian partisans near Lake Como and shot. His body was hung upside down in a square in Milan.
Mussolini founded fascism: one-party rule, violent nationalism and worship of the leader, a model that Hitler copied. His wars brought Italy defeat and ruin.
pts: Hitler's ally in the Second World War
